requirements.text: create a Dev Environment Setup checklist task and assign it to the HR Service Desk Group
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case_task WHERE hr_case_task_id = 150 AND parent_case = 10 AND task_type = 'checklist' AND short_description = 'Dev Environment Setup' AND assignment_group = 4 AND status = 'ready' AND active = true AND org_id = 1
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (highest hr_case_task_id on the seed is 149)
parent_case = 10: Marc Henry (user 20, profile 20) has two cases, and case 10 (New Hire Documentation) is his onboarding case; case 57 is an HR account access request
assignment_group = 4: the group named HR Service Desk

task_type checklist and short_description from the request's 'Dev Environment Setup checklist task'; the name is kept exact from the benchmark check, as 134 of the 149 seed tasks have short descriptions under 30 characters
status ready and active true: kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy
org_id = 1: kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy (it is the acting user's organisation)

disagreement: short_description: A LIKE '%Dev Environment Setup%', B = 'Dev Environment Setup'; chose the exact name because the benchmark's check is the prior and nothing contradicts it: the policy places the 30-120 character limit under case registration, and the seed's task short descriptions are bare names (134 of 149 under 30 characters)

notes:
disagreement: value: the task's short_description: one pass matches it as containing 'Dev Environment Setup' because of the policy's 30-120 character limit, the other tests the exact name; kept the exact name, which the benchmark tests and the seed's practice supports (134 of 149 tasks under 30 characters), so the task check's repair drops only the server-assigned number (logged on the requirement).
The two passes otherwise agree on every requirement, id, cell and disposition: task 150 on case 10 for group 4, and its two checklist items selected by description.
The request mentions that the final contractor experience survey is also missing but asks only for the Dev Environment Setup checklist task, so no survey task is required.
The policy says tasks must be assigned to an active user in the assignment group, but the request names only the group and no user, and no listed tool lists group members, so assigned_to is not tested.
The parent case 10 belongs to organisation 10 and its existing tasks carry org_id 10, whereas the benchmark expects org_id 1 (the acting user's organisation) on the new task and its items; org_id = 1 is kept as the benchmark's value.
The checklist rows depend on the task taking id 150.
